name: agent-link
description: Local-first agent pairing, chat, and context handoff for persistent and transient AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Pair local, LAN, or Tailnet agents for chat and context handoff.
interface.longDescription: Agent Link helps transient coding agents quickly connect to persistent personal agents. Version 0.1 focuses on discovery profiles, human-approved pairing assumptions, chat-only communication, environment briefings, and session handoff summaries. Tool grants are intentionally out of scope until a later scoped authorization layer is added.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Link to brief me from my persistent home agent.
Use Agent Link to ask my linked OpenClaw agent what context matters for this project.
Use Agent Link to send a handoff summary back to my persistent agent.
